touchpoints.name: Rendimiento servicios motor transacción
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Registro registro usuario transacción
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE name LIKE 'WebTransaction/%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Registro transacción consulta dato registro
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET appName SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Alerta registro red módulo
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE appName LIKE 'web-%' FACET appName SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Dato alerta
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM SyntheticCheck SINCE 30 minutes ago

touchpoints.name: Panel servicio tiempo
touchpoints.query: SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) FROM Span WHERE duration > 0.5 SINCE 24 hours ago

touchpoints.name: Columna entidad
touchpoints.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE error IS true FACET appName SINCE 1 hour ago

touchpoints.name: Motor estado transacción
touchpoints.query: SELECT average(duration) FROM Span WHERE entityGuid IS NOT NULL FACET name SINCE 30 minutes ago
